purpose: Read-only operational report of per-vehicle telemetry ingest volume, estimated storage, recent ingest rate and DLQ failures.
primaryGoal: Identify disproportionate telemetry consumers and compare them with the returned-report baseline without confusing estimates, missing measurements or limited results with unbounded fleet totals.

ownershipChain: internal\api\router.go:4563,4571,4584 constructs and registers the admin observability handler under the existing API group
internal\handler\v1\admin_observability_handler.go:36,76-92 registers the GET route, parses since/limit and responds with an envelope
internal\app\adminobssvc\service.go:175-183 handles missing configuration and a default trailing 30 days
internal\database\observability\vehicle_cost_repo.go:50-129 queries signal_log, vehicles and signal_log_failures; totals sum returned rows
dataSources.behavior: Page requests 100 vehicles. Hook query key includes since ISO and limit; forwards AbortSignal; unwraps data envelope; uses STANDARD stale time, SLOW polling, no background interval and retry 1 (hook lines 80-81,149-165). Router and registered handler agree with the relative hook path; there is no double /api/v1 prefix or camelCase query parameter.
sourceSemantics: Rows use ts >= since with no explicit upper bound; ordered by row count descending before LIMIT.
Estimated bytes equal row_count * 96, not measured disk footprint.
Rate counts selected-window rows also within server now() minus 24 hours, divided by 1440; not instantaneous rate.
DLQ counts use first_seen in the last 24 hours and join only returned ingest vehicles.
Totals aggregate only returned vehicles; tracked count and arithmetic mean use this capped result, not the entire fleet.
Missing-relation fallback retries without the DLQ join and supplies zero failures without availability metadata (repository lines 98-100,128-173; zero literal at line 144).
Actual database availability, query execution, schema population, network envelope and authentication behavior remain unverified.
dataSources.units: Operational counts, bytes and rows/minute; preserve raw wire/cache values and display-only byte/number formatting. No physical SI conversion is needed.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing shared formatting and saved-preference mechanisms, not a new page-specific formatter
dataSources.behavior: OperationalBrief adapter receives six raw metrics and source explanations. Chart/table/talkers use existing number/byte formatters. Formatting hook internals and preference persistence were not inspected or executed in this bounded audit.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.detail: Thin min-w-0/full-width container adapter over existing PageContainer, source notices, header action slots and error boundary. No replacement page-width or header engine.

components.name: VehicleCostStatStrip / OperationalBrief
components.detail: Six source-backed metrics, returned-result qualifiers, missing denominator, retained-source state and actionable query error. Shared summary owner already exists; do not restore six decorative MetricCards.

components.name: CostByVehicleChart / EmbeddedChart
components.detail: Horizontal top-eight estimated-byte chart with shared data columns, tooltip, axes and state frame. EmbeddedChart forwards children to ChartContainer; exportable/fullscreen default false, so do not invent existing chart export/fullscreen actions.

components.name: VehicleCostTalkers / LayoutCard / MetricBar / KVList
components.detail: Top-eight ranked row shares, known-zero fallback scale and missing-total partial list. MetricBar already supports solid fill and missing readings; use those capabilities rather than introducing a custom progress renderer.

components.name: VehicleCostTable / DataTable
components.detail: Six columns, canonical raw value filters, stable tableId, keyExtractor and section boundary. Shared DataTable owns persistence, export, mobile presentation and expansion; page must supply a non-lossy mobile strategy.

components.name: VehicleCostToolbar / Select / Button / Caption
components.detail: Localized window presets and named disabled/busy refresh control, currently bundled into contextActions.

components.name: DataStateNotice / QueryError / EmptyState / Skeleton / SectionErrorBoundary / FadeIn
components.owner: Existing feedback and motion category owners
components.detail: No new source-state registry, skeleton system or overlay. FadeIn explicitly respects shared motion preference; chart animation is disabled.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Barrel continues to export FleetCostKpis and TopTalkersPanel while mounted page imports VehicleCostStatStrip and VehicleCostTalkers from separate directories. Inspected alternatives duplicate the same six metrics and ranked-share panel with different missing-data behavior. Other consumers were not enumerated; unused status is not asserted.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Treat the mounted adapters as the current preservation baseline; reconcile callers/tests and barrel ownership before any consolidation. Do not transplant legacy zero defaults or delete alternatives without caller evidence.

sourceBehavior: PageLayout has full-width min-w-0 composition; table host also has min-w-0.
Breakdown stacks in one column below xl, then chart spans two of three columns (page lines 142-151; chart line 61).
Toolbar flex-wrap with sm spacing (toolbar line 46).
OperationalBrief receives compact and metricColumns=3; actual breakpoint behavior was not inspected or mounted.
Chart category axis reserves 128px and shortens labels after 18 characters; full names survive chart data columns (chart lines 79-80,103-105).

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / mission 15: mobile must retain all information
issues.detail: mobileColumns includes only vehicle, failures and last. Shared DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to all other columns (DataTable.tsx:714-725). Caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable details, so rows/bytes/rate are hidden in the narrow table. Other page panels do not expose these measurements for every returned vehicle.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobilePresentation or expansion with all six source columns accessible per row; preserve desktop column settings, filters, export scope, ID and source ordering. Do not solve by dropping the mobile allow-list without an intentional overflow/reflow strategy.

issues.detail: Fixed 128px category axis and 18-character truncation may leave a small plot at 320px. This is a source-identified review risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Exercise the canonical frame/data alternative with long labels at all required widths and 200% text before changing axis geometry; retain every plotted row and full name.

sourceStrengths: Named breakdown and summary sections; ranked talkers use ul/li semantics.
Refresh has localized aria-label, disabled state and aria-busy; label wraps the window Select (toolbar lines 47-65).
Chart provides localized ariaLabel and full-name/estimated-byte data columns (chart lines 66-85).
Talker loading uses role=status/aria-busy; missing total retains list content and partial notice (talkers lines 26-39).
Shared MetricBar supplies progressbar name/range and missing-reading aria-valuetext (MetricBar.tsx:51-64); actual composed announcement unverified.
FadeIn consumes useMotionPreference and suppresses reduced-motion entrance (FadeIn.tsx:25-34); bar chart isAnimationActive=false.
followUp: Review keyboard access to window, refresh, retries, chart data alternative and full table toolbar/filters on the mounted route.

Verify refresh spin is suppressed under OS reduced motion and low-bandwidth preference; toolbar directly uses animate-spin, while no local motion hook is used (toolbar line 64). Global CSS behavior was not inspected, so no confirmed motion failure is claimed.
Measure effective contrast in saved light/dark/custom/forced-color themes; text-cyan-300 and text-amber-300 are fixed feature accents, not measured theme-safe contrast.

states.initialLoading: deriveDataState initial drives six-metric loading, shared chart loading, five talker skeletons and table skeleton while keeping all four content blocks.
states.empty: Successful empty arrays retain summary and distinct empty chart/talker/table states; tracked vehicles can be measured zero while mean has no denominator.
states.fatalError: Fatal error passed to each section with refetch recovery; PageLayout remains composed. No global data gate drops all sections.
states.unsupported: Any fatal ApiError status 503 renders unsupported notice and suppresses section errors (page lines 63-68,114-124). This assumes all 503 responses mean missing subsystem; error code is not checked.
states.refresh: Query polling and manual refresh retain data; refresh disabled/busy while isFetching. Summary receives refreshError and retained flag; page source notice receives query except unsupported.
states.staleOffline: deriveDataState differentiates retained refresh failure and paused refresh; summary shows retained state. Page/source trust presentation is inherited; no browser/offline acceptance.
states.partialUnknown: Missing totals remain unknown in summary and top-talkers missing-total branch; rank helper and table failures still coerce missing source fields to zero.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045: unknown is not zero
issues.detail: rankVehicles coerces missing bytes, rows, rate and failures to zero (lines 59-62), defeating shared MetricBar missing-reading support. Table similarly renders missing failures as 0 at VehicleCostTable.tsx:86 although its filter label preserves an em dash.
issues.fix: Preserve source unknown/null/nonfinite states in the domain adapter and present unavailable readings without numeric fabrication. Resolve ranking policy for unknown sort values explicitly while retaining all returned rows and measured zero.

issues.rule: MDC-026: unsupported is not generic service failure
issues.detail: A generic fatal 503 is labeled unsupported without checking SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED. The inspected handler documents missing configuration, but other transient 503 paths were not traced.
issues.fix: Confirm structured error-code availability and discriminate missing configuration from transient service failure using existing ApiError contract; retain retry and source context.

issues.detail: Missing-DLQ-relation fallback emits a numeric 0 with no capability/availability flag. Frontend cannot distinguish measured no failures from unavailable failure storage using the current payload.
issues.fix: Integration owner must define and supply actual availability metadata before UI can label DLQ unavailable; do not invent a flag or reinterpret every legitimate zero locally.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-034 / mission 43: restrained semantic accents
visualIssues.detail: Eight ranked talkers rotate through chartTokens.series though color does not encode a distinct source category; MetricBar default fill is gradient (MetricBar.tsx:47,92). This is avoidable multi-hue/gradient emphasis for a single ranked measure, not a runtime screenshot finding.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer one restrained semantic series token and existing fill=solid, preserving labels, values, proportions and user palette preferences. Keep stronger emphasis only for meaningful outliers; no new hex palette or custom progress component.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative chart icon uses fixed cyan-300; talker action icon uses fixed amber-300 and table failures use amber-300. Not neon classes, but unnecessary decorative hue can compete with data and fixed failure text needs actual theme contrast review.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted semantic icon/text tokens for decoration and existing warning severity for real nonzero failures. Retain meaningful amber outlier highlight and saved chart palette semantics; verify themes rather than force-resetting preferences.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 / mission 33: one workspace range owner
architectureIssues.detail: Local windowDays/since drives a separate Window Select. Route is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77) and /admin disables global vehicle selection (workspaceScope.ts:96-108,154-166). Report is correctly fleet-wide, but dated range has a competing local owner. Backend accepts since only, not a bounded range.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate workspace/date and API integration owners: register actual route only when useRangeState and server filtering support both bounds with correct rolling/custom/timezone semantics. Preserve 1/7/30/90-day intent and default 30 days; do not merely hide the old control or add a header control that cannot affect the query. Keep fleet-wide vehicle scope.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 / MDC-046: explicit query period semantics
architectureIssues.detail: since is memoized only on windowDays, so SLOW polling/manual refetch reuses the initial lower bound; a selected trailing period becomes longer while page stays mounted. API response provides neither exact bounds nor an upper bound.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current request semantics as audit baseline, then explicitly reconcile rolling versus fixed period with existing range-state owner and source bounds metadata. Do not silently change period calculations during cosmetic modernization.

architectureIssues.rule: mission 0 / MDC-023: source claims versus wired actions
architectureIssues.detail: Comment says six sortable columns, but columns have no sortable flag and DataTable caller supplies no onSort/sortKey/sortDir. Shared DataTable only renders sort controls with sortable and onSort (DataTable.tsx:1557). Actual source wires six value-filterable columns, not interactive sort.
architectureIssues.fix: Record existing server order and filters accurately; reconcile intended sorting with source/history and tests before implementing via existing DataTable/useSortToggle. Do not assert sorting is an existing working action or discard filters to add it.

priority.rationale: Mobile detail loss and unknown-as-zero risk outrank aesthetic changes. Resolve source availability and range ownership through integration; then reduce multi-hue/gradient noise using already implemented shared APIs.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Workspace range / server-bound report integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing range owner startInstant/endInstantExclusive and route registration; typed useVehicleCost bounds and explicit report period metadata; retain rolling/custom/timezone semantics and fleet-wide vehicle scope.

requiredSharedChanges.name: DLQ availability provenance
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Source capability/availability information for failure counters when fallback query is used; typed payload propagated through existing hook/data-state mechanisms; distinguish known zero from unavailable without inventing backend guarantees.
dependsOn: Shared wire types and handler response contract

competingImplementations.evidence: Page imports mounted current owner at line 42; barrel exports alternative at line 10. Alternative uses six MetricCards and default-zero totals; current uses OperationalBrief and richer source qualifiers.
competingImplementations.decision: Do not revive alternative or create a third stats implementation. Reconcile consumers before removal; no global usage/dead-code claim.

competingImplementations.evidence: Page imports current at line 43; barrel exports alternative at line 12. Current preserves missing total with partial KVList; alternative treats missing total as zero and uses largest-talker scale.
competingImplementations.decision: Current null-total handling must survive consolidation; reuse LayoutCard/MetricBar/KVList rather than adding a new shared domain renderer.

competingImplementations.evidence: Page lines 55-61,91-98 versus workspaceScope route opt-in list and scope result.
competingImplementations.decision: Integration requirement above is the sole range-owner proposal; no second range picker, local bypass or speculative component.

sections.name: Ingest cost by vehicle
sections.behavior: Top eight estimated-byte consumers, descending; highest highlighted; byte axes/tooltip and full-name data alternative.

sections.name: Top talkers
sections.behavior: Top eight row consumers, descending; rows and percent, capped 100%; known-total scale including known-zero fallback, missing total yields partial KVList.

structuralCounts.note: Shared adapters, not direct page GlassPanel count, establish section preservation. EmbeddedChart forwards to canonical ChartContainer. Source counts are not mounted runtime counts.

Preserve source order in full table and separate top-eight descending bytes/rows derives; trimming names falls back to localized Vehicle #id.
